description: Staging manifest for the state-lib state backend A/B build. Names only, never values.

notes.DATABASE_URL: Must point at a dedicated staging database, never the production one.
notes.APP_ORIGIN: Public origin of the staging deployment only.
notes.OWNER_EMAIL: Synthetic address on the example.invalid domain.
notes.AUTH_SECRET: Fresh random value generated for staging; never reused from production.
notes.LOCAL_TEST_MODE: Server code refuses LOCAL_TEST_MODE on Vercel, so remote staging needs a real staging sign-in provider (client id and secret names above); the coordinator must supply that capability.
